title: 开源杀出重围！OpenAI 亲述：如何把Codex变成谁都能装进产品里的“智能体引擎”
raw_text: 在编程 Agent 的闭源竞赛中，OpenAI 携用 Rust 重写的 Codex 走出了一条完全不同的开源平台化路线。本文深度拆解了 OpenAI 官方最新披露的 Codex Agent Harness 架构体系：通过 codex exec、Codex SDK、app-server 三大分级集成方案，配合 Relay 运营看板实战，展示如何将强大的 Agent 循环、状态管理与沙箱执行原生嵌入企业自有的业务系统与工作流中。结合 ARC-AGI-3 测试中 Harness 调优使模型跑分翻三倍的硬核数据，文章揭示了“Agent 进产品，而非产品进 Agent”的全新工程范式。
reason_zh: OpenAI开源Codex Harness，提供三大集成方案和实战数据，对工程实践极具参考价值。
summary_zh: 本文深度拆解OpenAI官方披露的Codex Agent Harness架构，展示了其开源平台化路线。通过codex exec、Codex SDK、app-server三大分级集成方案，配合Relay运营看板，实现Agent循环、状态管理与沙箱执行的原生嵌入。文章引用ARC-AGI-3测试中Harness调优使模型跑分翻三倍的数据，强调'Agent进产品，而非产品进Agent'的工程范式。对于希望将AI Agent集成到业务系统的开发者，提供了详细的架构设计和实践指导。
title_zh: 开源杀出重围！OpenAI亲述：如何把Codex变成谁都能装进产品里的'智能体引擎'

title: AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter
raw_text:
AI agents have consumed more tokens than humans on OpenRouter since February 6, 2025. Agentic usage has grown 14x since then, while human usage is up just 2.8x. Nearly 70 percent of agent token consumption comes from cheap cached prompts, though, so actual costs are rising far more slowly than the raw numbers suggest.

The article AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter appeared first on The Decoder.
reason_zh: AI代理消耗token激增14倍，揭示AI成为自身最大客户，对理解行业趋势有重要价值。
summary_zh: OpenRouter数据显示，自2025年2月6日起，AI代理消耗的token数量已超过人类，且代理使用量增长14倍，而人类使用量仅增长2.8倍。目前近70%的token消耗来自AI代理。这一趋势表明，AI系统正在成为AI服务的主要消费者，可能推动基础设施和商业模式变革。文章分析了这一现象对AI行业的影响，包括成本结构、模型训练和部署策略等。
title_zh: AI正成为AI的最大客户：OpenRouter上代理token使用量激增14倍

title: cline/cline v4.1.14
raw_text:
Everything here lands through the SDK bundle, so it applies to windows running that bundle.

### Added

- Refresh the built-in model catalog. New entries include Claude Fable 5, Grok 4.6 on Vertex, several DeepSeek V4 Flash variants (including the vision preview), MiMo v2.5, Qwen3.8 27B, Gemma 4 26B, LongCat 2.0, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, and Thinking Machines' Inkling models.

### Fixed

- Restore task completion telemetry for interactive sessions. A share of interactive stops routed through a teardown path that never reported completion after 4.1.11 changed how session status is tracked; every session now reports it exactly once.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.13...v4.1.14

title: LMCache/LMCache nightly-rocm
raw_text:
Nightly ROCm 7.2 wheels built from `dev` on 2026-08-23,
for AMD Instinct gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X),
ABI-matched to the upstream `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` image
(torch 2.11, cp312).

Install into an upstream vLLM ROCm container:
```
pip install lmcache==0.5.5.dev11+rocm7.2 --no-deps \
  --find-links https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache/releases/expanded_assets/nightly-rocm
```

title: How China's gray market sells Claude tokens at a fraction of the price
raw_text:
Anthropic's strict access controls against China, from geoblocking to selfie verification, are being systematically bypassed through a thriving network of so-called "transfer stations." Chinese developers can buy Claude tokens for as little as ten percent of the list price. Analyst Zilan Qian warns that the circumvention infrastructure weakens export controls and Anthropic's own safety systems.
